name: io.tru8/mcp-server
title: Tru8 Evidence Research
description: Structured evidence research for AI agents. Submit claims or URLs, retrieve evidence organized by source tier (primary/reporting/commentary) and type (data/official/news/analysis/opinion/academic), with element decomposition and relationship mapping (supports/challenges/context).

environmentVariables.name: TRU8_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Tru8 API key (tru8_sk_...). Create at dashboard → Settings → Developer.

tools.name: tru8_check_claim
tools.description: Submit text or URL for full evidence research (60-120s). Returns claims, elements, evidence maps, and computed analytics.

tools.name: tru8_quick_check
tools.description: Quick evidence snapshot (12-18s). Returns claims with raw evidence, no decomposition or mapping.

tools.name: tru8_get_result
tools.description: Retrieve completed check with pre-computed analytics (tier/type distributions, corroboration, diagnostics).

tools.name: tru8_get_result_raw
tools.description: Retrieve raw check data without computed analytics.
